text.zh-CN:
急性胃肠炎常表现为腹泻、呕吐和腹部不适，多数病毒性病例数日内改善。

- 腹泻指排便明显变稀或变频繁，呕吐和腹泻都可让身体丢失水和盐。
- 这里介绍常见感染性胃肠炎；便血、剧烈局部腹痛或持续恶化不能都按普通肠胃不适处理。
text.en:
Acute gastroenteritis commonly causes diarrhoea, vomiting and abdominal discomfort; many viral cases improve in days.

- Loose or frequent stools and vomiting can both remove water and salts from the body.
- This page covers common infectious illness; blood, severe localised pain or deterioration needs separate assessment.

text.zh-CN:
病因可包括病毒，也可有细菌或其他病原体。

- 接触呕吐物、粪便污染的手、食物或物品可传播感染。
- 共同进餐后多人发病是重要线索，就诊时应说明。
- 婴儿、老人和免疫受抑者更容易因丢水出现问题。
text.en:
Viruses are common, but bacteria and other pathogens also cause illness.

- Hands, food or objects contaminated by stool or vomit can spread infection.
- Several people becoming ill after a shared meal is useful information for assessment.
- Infants, older adults and immunosuppressed people are more vulnerable to fluid loss.

text.zh-CN:
严重脱水或不典型症状需紧急处理。

- 意识异常、明显虚弱、尿极少或无法把水喝进去，应立即评估。
- 呕血、绿色呕吐物、突然剧烈腹痛或呼吸困难需急诊。
- 血便、持续高热或婴儿停止吃奶需及时求医，不自行用止泻药掩盖。
text.en:
Severe dehydration or atypical symptoms require urgent care.

- Altered alertness, marked weakness, very little urine or inability to retain fluids needs immediate assessment.
- Blood or green vomit, sudden severe abdominal pain or breathing difficulty warrants emergency care.
- Bloody stools, persistent fever or an infant stopping feeds needs prompt advice rather than self-treatment with anti-diarrhoeals.

text.zh-CN:
轻症以补液观察为主，出现恶化则升级就医。

- 成人清醒、能饮水并正常排尿时可先居家休息。
- 持续呕吐喝不进水、补液后仍尿少，或腹泻超过7天、呕吐超过2天，应联系医生。
- 小婴儿、老人及免疫受抑者更早咨询，不等同成人观察期限。
text.en:
Mild illness mainly needs fluids and observation, with escalation for worsening.

- An alert adult who drinks and urinates normally may start home care.
- Persistent inability to retain fluids, low urine despite rehydration, diarrhoea beyond seven days or vomiting beyond two days needs advice.
- Young infants, older adults and immunosuppressed people should seek earlier guidance.

text.zh-CN:
病史和脱水程度决定是否检查。

- 说明发病时间、次数、血便、发热、旅行及共同进餐情况。
- 医生查看精神状态、口干、尿量和循环情况，必要时查血液或粪便。
- 轻症通常不必查出具体病毒；长期、严重或带血腹泻需要更有针对性的评估。
text.en:
History and hydration determine testing.

- Report timing, frequency, blood, fever, travel and shared meals.
- The clinician assesses alertness, dryness, urine and circulation and may request blood or stool tests.
- Mild illness often needs no specific viral test; prolonged, severe or bloody diarrhoea requires targeted assessment.

text.zh-CN:
呕吐腹泻并不全部是病毒感染。

- 食物相关细菌感染、药物副作用及其他肠道疾病也可引起腹泻。
- 持续局部剧烈腹痛需排查阑尾炎等腹部急症。
- 发热或血便提示应重新评估，不简单套用普通病毒性胃肠炎方案。
text.en:
Vomiting and diarrhoea are not always viral.

- Foodborne bacterial illness, medicine effects and other bowel conditions can cause diarrhoea.
- Persistent severe local pain needs assessment for abdominal emergencies such as appendicitis.
- Fever or blood should prompt review rather than automatic use of a routine viral-illness plan.

text.zh-CN:
首要目标是补回水和电解质，即身体需要的盐分。

- 口服补液盐按包装规定水量冲调，少量多次喝，勿随意加浓或加糖。
- 无法口服或严重脱水时可能需要医院静脉补液。
- 病毒感染多靠自身恢复，抗生素对病毒无效；特定其他病因另行处理。
text.en:
The priority is replacing water and electrolytes, the salts the body needs.

- Mix oral rehydration solution with the exact stated water amount and sip frequently; do not concentrate it or add sugar.
- Inability to drink or severe dehydration may require intravenous fluids.
- Most viral illness resolves naturally; antibiotics do not treat viruses and other causes need separate care.

text.zh-CN:
止吐和止泻药的选择需考虑年龄、症状及是否发热或便血。

- 口服补液盐用于纠正丢水丢盐，不是止泻药，也不要求腹泻立刻停止。
- 洛哌丁胺等可短暂减轻部分成人腹泻；发热或血便时不要自行使用。
- 儿童尤其婴幼儿不可照搬成人止泻药方案，严重呕吐由医生决定是否用止吐药。
text.en:
Medicine choices depend on age, symptoms, fever and bloody stools.

- Oral rehydration solution replaces losses rather than immediately stopping diarrhoea.
- Loperamide may temporarily help selected adults but should not be self-used with fever or bloody stools.
- Children, especially infants, need separate advice; a clinician decides whether severe vomiting needs medicine.

text.zh-CN:
能吃时恢复可耐受的普通食物，不必长期禁食。

- 少量进食，油腻或辛辣会加重不适时暂避开。
- 果汁和汽水可能加重腹泻，脱水风险者优先规范补液盐。
- 母乳或常规浓度配方奶通常继续，不把配方奶冲稀。
text.en:
Resume tolerated ordinary food when able rather than prolonged fasting.

- Eat small portions and avoid fatty or spicy food if it worsens symptoms.
- Juice or fizzy drinks can worsen diarrhoea; use proper rehydration solution when dehydration is a concern.
- Usually continue breast milk or normal-strength formula rather than diluting feeds.

text.zh-CN:
居家照护兼顾补液和减少传播。

- 记录喝入多少、尿量及精神变化，呕吐时从小口开始。
- 用肥皂和水洗手，清洁厕所和污染物，不为他人准备食物。
- NHS建议最后一次呕吐腹泻后至少48小时再返校返工，特殊行业按当地规定。
text.en:
Home care combines hydration and infection control.

- Track intake, urine and alertness and use small sips during vomiting.
- Wash with soap and water, clean toilets and contamination and avoid preparing others' food.
- NHS advises at least 48 hours after the last vomiting or diarrhoea before school or work; special occupations follow local rules.

text.zh-CN:
丢水风险决定咨询要更早。

- 婴儿少湿尿布、停止吃奶或难以唤醒，需要及时评估。
- 老人和免疫受抑者可能更快脱水，应及早使用合适补液方案。
- 心肾病或限液患者的补液量由医疗团队指导，不强套多喝水。
text.en:
Fluid-loss risk means earlier advice for some people.

- Few wet nappies, stopping feeds or difficulty waking an infant needs prompt assessment.
- Older or immunosuppressed people may dehydrate faster and need early rehydration guidance.
- Heart or kidney patients with fluid restrictions need a team-guided amount rather than a blanket instruction to drink more.

text.zh-CN:
多数短程感染逐步自行改善。

- NHS介绍呕吐常在1至2天缓解，腹泻常在5至7天内停止，但不是每个人相同。
- 恢复进食和尿量比只看排便次数更重要。
- 超过预期、反复恶化或新发血便，应复诊寻找其他病因。
text.en:
Most short infections improve gradually.

- NHS describes vomiting commonly settling in one to two days and diarrhoea in five to seven, with individual variation.
- Returning intake and urine output matter alongside stool frequency.
- A longer course, renewed worsening or new blood needs reassessment.

text.zh-CN:
主要并发症是脱水和盐分失衡。

- 可能出现口干、尿少、站起发晕，严重时循环和肾功能受影响。
- 持续不能进食饮水者需及时补液，不以强忍等待自愈。
- 免疫受抑或特殊感染的风险更高，需要按病因随访。
text.en:
Dehydration and electrolyte imbalance are the main complications.

- Dry mouth, low urine and standing dizziness can progress to circulation or kidney problems.
- Persistent inability to eat or drink needs rehydration rather than simply waiting.
- Immunosuppression or particular infections can carry additional risks requiring cause-specific follow-up.

text.zh-CN:
阻断粪口传播是关键。

- 如厕后和做饭前用肥皂洗手，生熟食分开并注意安全水源。
- 污染衣物和床品分开清洗，定期清洁共用厕所，不共用毛巾。
- 发病后仍可能传播，按当地返校返工和食品从业规定恢复活动。
text.en:
Interrupting faecal–oral spread is central.

- Wash hands after toilets and before food preparation, separate raw and cooked foods and use safe water.
- Wash soiled laundry separately, clean shared toilets and avoid sharing towels.
- Transmission may continue after symptoms; follow local return-to-school, work and food-handling rules.

limitations.zh-CN: 面向普通读者的扩充医学信息草稿，已核读所列官方资料的相关章节；逐项独立论证、地区适用性核准及医学签审尚未完成，不构成个体诊断或处方。
limitations.en: Expanded educational draft based on inspected official patient-information sections. Independent claim verification, regional applicability review and clinical sign-off remain pending; this is not an individual diagnosis or prescription.
